Give me a one-paragraph summary of this patient's MRI history.

MRI history (record organization only): baseline MRI 2026-01-12 noted a 3.2 cm right-breast mass. Interim MRI 2026-03-18 noted a 2.1 cm mass with partial interval decrease. No mention of distant disease in either report. The assistant cannot interpret response category; clinician review of the original report wording remains required.
